passage.wordUpload: Upload a Word file to load MULTIPLE passages automatically (DOC/DOCX)
passage.wordHelp: Your file needs passage separator lines (e.g. "Passage 1:", "Bài đọc 2:"). The questions below each one are automatically assigned to the right passage. If a passage has MULTIPLE paragraphs, separate them with lines "Đoạn 2:", "Đoạn 3:"… (the first paragraph needs no marker); put them before the "Dịch:" line if there is one.
passage.jsonUpload: Or upload a JSON file to load MULTIPLE passages (more accurate)
passage.jsonHelp: Loads the groups in the JSON file’s groups, no separator lines needed. Sample file: docs/question-import-sample.json. Note: JSON does not carry audio/image files - use the mediaUrl of an uploaded file, or add media below after loading.
